statement: In HIDMaestro's pinned emulated descriptor, report ID 0x21 declares 37 data bytes, while the persona and published USB endpoint use a 37-byte input transfer total. A conventional report-ID-plus-payload interpretation would require 38 bytes; do not silently correct the descriptor or equate the HID declaration to a verified physical report length. The interpretation and any host parser outcome are not tested here.

applicability.revision: public reports for 0x057e:0x0337; hardware revision unverified
applicability.scope: Reported HID field count versus input packet length in an emulator; inference only
